verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth documents an official client library. It covers creating Supabase clients for SSR frameworks like Next.js and SvelteKit, automatic JWT handling on every API call, and an `accessToken` option, all under a JavaScript auth-api reference. Community feedback points to coverage gaps: one user yearned for a first-party iOS SDK, and another said React Native OAuth guidance was thin. Missing for 10: evidence of SDK breadth across languages and platforms (e.g., first-party iOS/mobile SDKs), detailed SDK reference content, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
